cells.value: One row per app, built by work/2026-10-01_app-decisions/build_decisions.py from All connections (status, notes, target_home), the tool cards in ~/.agents/tools/cards and the Route power tab. Rerun the script; don't hand-edit this tab. Keeper = the route marked THE route in All connections, else the working Composio route (one per account). ADD TO COMPOSIO = no proven keeper yet: run tool-card; nothing is removable until one is proven.

Removal lists are proposals checked against the tool cards, not authorization. A route is proposed only when All connections marks it Remove and a duplicate, it reaches the same account as a proven keeper, and the app's tool card names that keeper. Composio routes, plugins and connectors, 1Password, hub plumbing, local CLIs, Javar's fence and anything marked Stays, Keep, Leave off or Decide are never proposed. Before removing a proposed route, re-read its tool card and its All connections row, prove the keeper still works and back it up to ~/Backups. Only then does the standing yes apply, and only to CUT DUPLICATES rows.
